parameters.name: SpecialKey
parameters.description: 根据**SpecialType**填写对应的AppId或者阿里云账号ID（账号ID请到[账号管理](https://account.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.3f053654YpMPwo#/secure)页面查看）

parameters.name: SpecialType
parameters.description:
特殊流控类型，可选值：

- **APP**：应用
- **USER**：用户

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi add-traffic-special-control --traffic-control-id tf123456 --special-type APP --special-key 3382463 --traffic-value 10000 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi AddTrafficSpecialControl --region cn-hangzhou --SpecialKey 3382463 --TrafficControlId tf123456 --SpecialType APP --TrafficValue 10000
